scope: Q10 bounded internal predicate prerequisite only; P0/P1/P2 and graph operations remain incomplete.
working_tree: Includes pre-existing uncommitted foundation edits and verification relocation. Source hashes identify evaluated content.

profile.qualification: Provisional; no device workload capacity claim.

implementation_choice: Postfix binary Boolean tokens with a validated caller-owned copy; compared with prefix and indexed-tree alternatives. No recursion or allocation.

host_foundations.result: 1/1 tests passed; seven unchanged foundation groups; ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer.

predicate_boundaries.result: Passed with ASan/UBSan/LeakSanitizer; 65600 truth-table/high-bit evaluations and 20 output-preserving rejection checks, plus depth/size/copy/alias assertions.
cases: A; A OR B; (A OR B) AND C; any pair of three; TRUE; redundant/repeated references; FALSE branch
Zero/maximum/excess declared channels, exact maximum token count, both skew directions at depth boundary, malformed operators/arity/references, null arguments
Invalid reference behind TRUE OR and FALSE AND; P(all) false; unchanged destination after rejection; source-copy independence; overlapping input

independent_tree_oracle.algorithm: Reconstruct tree recursively backward from postfix; recursive Boolean evaluation independent of production fixed-stack interpreter.
independent_tree_oracle.coverage: Exhaustive six-token vocabulary sequences of length 0..6; all 256 kind/reference bytes; count/depth/channel boundaries; balanced/skewed trees; 4000 generated trees and mutations; all subsets for at most four channels.

esp32.result: Shared component compiled and foundation firmware linked; no hardware execution.
esp32.stack_note: Static function-frame estimates from existing ESP-IDF compile flags plus -fstack-usage, not measured task stack/high-water usage; excludes callees.
esp32.limitation: Predicate object built in the component; unchanged foundation fixture does not call it, so firmware link does not establish target predicate execution.

test_preservation: 25 existing test/model/ESP fixture files matched the pre-turn working-tree hashes; no test files added or modified in the repository.
sandbox_note: LeakSanitizer cannot run under sandbox process tracing. Approved runs outside the sandbox passed.
observation: Synchronous deterministic checks; no protocol workers, clock, injected transport faults, resource allocations or outstanding cleanup obligations. No telemetry channel used.
